SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class SolidFlashDepositSource

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.SolidFlashDepositSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, DepositSource
public class SolidFlashDepositSource extends Object implements DepositSource
DepositSource that computes a solid-precipitation deposition rate from a process stream using a NeqSim solid (TP-solid) flash.

This covers solids that the equation of state can drop out directly, most importantly elemental sulfur (S8), but also wax or asphaltene when those solid checks are configured. The stream is cloned, multi-phase and the named solid-phase check are enabled, a TPSolidflash is run at the stream conditions, and the resulting solid-phase mass rate is multiplied by a capture fraction (the fraction of precipitated solids that stick to the impeller rather than pass through).

The stream should represent the fluid entering the compressor, including any entrained liquid (condensate/water droplets) carried over from an upstream separator, since the entrained liquid is where dissolved sulfur or salt is transported. Model entrainment upstream by mixing the carried-over liquid into the compressor feed (or by an imperfect separator efficiency).

1.0

    • setEvaluationConditions

      public void setEvaluationConditions(double temperatureC, double pressureBara)
      Evaluate precipitation at a local equipment temperature and pressure rather than at the bulk inlet-stream conditions. This is useful when entrained condensate reaches a warmer compressor shaft or seal surface and evaporates locally.
      Parameters:
      temperatureC - local temperature in Celsius, or NaN to use the stream temperature
      pressureBara - local pressure in bara, or NaN to use the stream pressure

    • setThermalNode

      public void setThermalNode(Compressor compressor, String nodeId)
      Use a local temperature from an attached compressor thermal model for every evaluation. Pressure defaults to the compressor inlet pressure unless an explicit evaluation pressure was set first.
      Parameters:
      compressor - compressor with an attached and solved thermal model
      nodeId - thermal node identifier, for example CompressorThermalModel.INLET_SHAFT
